```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(scholar)

scholar_id <- "Vf6gRpIAAAAJ"
profile <- get_profile(scholar_id)

h_index <- profile$h_index
i10_index <- profile$i10_index
total_citations <- profile$total_cites
retrieval_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%B %d, %Y")
```
**H-index:** `r h_index` | **i10-index:** `r i10_index` | **Total citations:** `r total_citations` *(retrieved from Google Scholar on `r retrieval_date`)*
